scope: compare historical marginal 1st/2nd repair contribution, no new inference

second_repair_rescued_case.mechanism_observed: unquoted ProductName/ProductID/CustomerName etc. converted into quoted physical identifiers containing spaces

decision: RETAIN max_repairs=2; DO NOT switch to 1 based only on historical DEV100. Second repair did rescue an EX-correct answer on independent BIRD TRAIN VAL64. Expensive retries deserve selective error-driven diagnostic, not blanket removal.
cost_note: On historical DEV100, 10 cases used two repairs without EX rescue; on independent TRAIN64, 14 two-repair cases produced one EX rescue. These are small, dataset-dependent and both exposed research cohorts.
prospective_mechanism: Test schema-normalized identifier repair as a deterministic, uniquely grounded alternative to an extra Qwen call; must verify failure modes and no regressions on entirely new physical DB sources before promotion.
inferential_limitations: does not establish optimal global max_repairs
